answer: Reputation decay resists sybils: standing is not won once and kept, it erodes each epoch unless refreshed by genuine work, bending and thinning like a willow over the tundra. A fake farm can flash briefly, but every idle clone's weight fades from bright to faded pigment the instant it stops contributing. Attackers must keep each of a thousand accounts busy forever — a one-time swarm becomes a permanent, compounding bill.
